Korali Rabagirana yo muri ADEPR Gatsata, ahazwi nka Gariraya, yashyize hanze indirimbo nshya yitwa “Wa Musaraba”, igaruka ku mumaro w’umusaraba Yesu Kristo yabambweho n’icyo igitambo cye gisobanuye ku bakristo.

Perezida wa Rabagirana Choir, Eric Kagiraneza, yatangaje ko iyi ndirimbo yanditswe na Gad Byiringiro, ikaba igamije gufasha abayumva kurushaho gusobanukirwa n’akamaro k’urupfu rwa Yesu Kristo ku musaraba.

Yagize ati: “Ni indirimbo ivuga Kristo, yanditswe na Gad Byiringiro. Irimo ubutumwa busobanura umumaro w’umusaraba Kristo yabambweho n’icyo watumariye nk’abakristo.”

Rabagirana Choir igizwe n’abaririmbyi 75, biganjemo urubyiruko. Imaze gushyira hanze indirimbo icyenda na album imwe, zirimo “Ndaririmba”, “Uwiteka Ndamukunda”, “Mfite Ibyiringiro”, “Ya Nkomo” na “Wa Musaraba”.

Kagiraneza yavuze ko intego y’iyi korali ari ugukomeza kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza bwa Yesu Kristo binyuze mu ndirimbo, ikagera ku bantu benshi bashoboka.

Ati: “Icyerekezo cya Rabagirana ni ivugabutumwa ryagutse mu ndirimbo zo kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza.”

Yasobanuye ko kuba urubyiruko rwiganje muri iyi korali ari imwe mu mbaraga zayo mu gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda z’ivugabutumwa.

Mu mishinga bafite, harimo kuzamura urwego rw’imiririmbire, kunoza amajwi no gukoresha injyana zigezweho, ariko ubutumwa bwiza bugakomeza kuba ipfundo ry’indirimbo zabo.

Ati: “Umushinga wa mbere ukomeye dufite ni ukuzamura urwego rw’imiririmbire, tukabasha kuririmba ubutumwa bwiza mu njyana zigezweho ndetse n’amajwi agororotse neza, ku buryo ababyumva bumva uburyohe bw’amajwi ndetse n’ubutumwa bwiza bubahumuriza.”

Rabagirana Choir ifite intego y’uko mu 2030 ubutumwa izaba imaze kugeza ku bantu binyuze mu ndirimbo buzaba bwafashije benshi kwakira Kristo.

Kagiraneza ati: “Twifuza ko mu mwaka wa 2030 hazaba hari umubare munini w’abantu bakiriye Kristo, binyuze mu butumwa bwiza buzaba bwamaze gusohoka mu ndirimbo za korali.”

Mu mashusho y’indirimbo “Wa Musaraba” hagaragaramo Manzi Tecquero, umubyinnyi wo muri Sherry Silver Foundation.

Kagiraneza yasobanuye ko atari umuririmbyi wa Rabagirana Choir, ahubwo ko basanzwe baziranye binyuze mu bikorwa bya muzika.

Ati: “Ntabwo Tecquero ari umuririmbyi wacu. Twari dusanzwe tuziranye kuko hari igihe yajyaga aba ari muri band ya muzika akadufasha kuvuza ingoma.”

Uretse gukora indirimbo, Rabagirana Choir irateganya gutangiza ibitaramo ngarukakwezi yise Rabagirana Festival, bigamije gukomeza kwamamaza ubutumwa bwiza no kwegera abakunzi bayo.

Ikaze mu kiganiro c'imvo n'imvano co kuri uyu wa gatandatu igenekerezo rya 17 ukwezi kwa cumi mu 2026

Intambara yo mu buseruko bwa Repuburika ya Demokasi ya Congo yoba igiye guhindura isura?

Ni kimwe mu bibazo vyinshi kuva hashinzwe FRN, Front pour la Refondation de la Nation, urunani rushasha rurongowe n'uwahoze ari umukuru w'ico gihugu Joseph Kabila Kabange.

Ni urunani rufatanya politike n'ibigwanisho mu kurondera guhindura intwaro muri Congo.

Mu bitari bike, nta bishasha kuri urwo runani.

Joseph Kabila afise ivyegera bitatu, Corneille Nangaa na Bertrand Bisimwa hamwe na Emmanuel Sultan Makenga afatanya ayo mabanga no kuba umukuru w'ingabo zegamiye urwo runani, ARC – Armée Révolutionnaire Congolaise. Abo bose bahora barongoye urunani AFC/M23 rwashinzwe mu mpera za 2023.

Hari kandi na Freddy Kaniki, umukuru wa MRDP-Twirwaneho, yashizwe mu kibanza c'umunyamabanga mukuru w'urwo runani.

Gishasha ni uwubaye umukuru w'urwo runani rushasha. Joseph Kabila, yabaye umukuru w'ico gihugu ca Congo imyaka 18.

Reta ya Kinshasa yagumye yagiriza Prezida Kabira ko ari we ari inyuma y'abagwanyi ba AFC/M23 ariko we akabihakana.

Itariki 30 z'ukwezi kw'icenda, sentare ya gisirikare yaciriye urubanza rwo gupfa Joseph Kabira atari ho ari, imuhamije ivyaha vyo mu ntambara n'ivyo guhemuka.

Kabila yagumye ahakana kugira aho bahuriye na AFC/M23 ubu igenzura ibisagara binini vyo mu buseruko bwa Congo, Goma na Bukavu.

Mu kwezi kwa kane uyu mwaka, Reta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zarafatiye ibihano prezida Kabila, zimwagiriza gufasha mu buryo bw'amafaranga na politike umuhari wa AFC/M23.

Aho agaragariye i Goma mu kwezi kwa gatanu mu 2025, hari benshi babibonyemwo kwemeza ivyahora bikekwa.

Itangazo ry'uwo muhari mushasha wa FRN ryashizwe ahabona inyuma y'imisi itatu Kabila ashikirije ijambo igihugu, aho yavuga ko mu misi no mu dwi ziri imbere azosigura neza ingene abanye Congo bokora mu ntumbero yo gutabara igihugu cabo.

Muri iryo jambo yagirije prezida Felix Tshisekedi ubu ari ku butegetsi kwirengagiza ivyo yasavye mw'ijambo yari yashikirije mu kwezi kwa gatanu umwaka uheze, harimwo n'icokorwa kugira intambara zo mu buseruko bwa Congo ngo zirangire.

Yanavuze kandi ku banyepolitike batavuga rumwe na reta n'abasirikare benshi bapfungwa bazira ubusa. Hari kandi ko ubutegetsi ubu ngo butubahirije ibwirizwa shingiro, gukoresha nabi ubutunzi bw'igihugu no kunanirwa kugarukana umutekano. Ikindi yavuze n'uko ngo reta ya Tshisekedi iguma yinjiza mu gisirikare abagwanyi ba FDLR na ADF.

Ubu rero ibibazo ni vyinshi: Ko Kabila yari yarahakanye gukorana na AFC/M23, ubu bakaba bari kumwe muri urwo runani rushasha, ntaco bari basanzwe bapfana koko? Kuki AFC/M23 yemeye kwinjira mu runani rushasha?

Kazoza ka AFC/M23, ibiganiro wagiyemwo n'amasezerano uwo muhari wari warashizeko umukono ni akahe?

Kubera iki Prezida Kabila ashimye kwigaragaza ubu? Nk'uwahoze ari umukuru w'igihugu, umuntu yaciriwe igihano co gupfa, akaba ku bihano vya Amerika, inguvu nshasha azanye mu rugamba rwahahora rwa AFC/M23 canke intambanyi bashobora guhura kubera iryo zina n'igihagararo vyiwe ni izahe?

Inkurikizi ku banyagihugu bari bafise icizere ku masezerano ya Washington yo guhagarika intambara ni izihe?

Ibi ni bimwe mu bibazo twaganiriye muri iki kiganiro mwateguriwe kandi mugiye gushikirizwa na Cyriaque Muhawenayo.

1. Dr Joseph Sebarenzi yigisha muri kaminuza ya School for International Training muri Reta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika

2. Dr Zenon Ndayisenga umwigisha muri kaminuza ya Pretoria muri Afrika y'Epfo.
